description: Change a film's metadata (title, short_description (30–160 characters to publish), full synopsis (at least 150 characters to publish), director and cast lines, year, original_language, genres from the fixed list, country of production, what it was shot on (capture_formats, cameras, camera_model), tech_specs, student_film, filming_locations, awards (checked by the Vidreno team before they show publicly), IMDb link, extra links, the AI disclosure mostly_ai_generated shown as 'Made with AI' on the film page, age_rating (all, 13, 16 or 18 — required to publish; 18+ titles ask viewers to confirm their age before playback) and content_descriptors (sexual content or nudity require age_rating 18), allow_search_engines: off keeps the page reachable by link but hides it from search engines and the sitemap, show_view_count: off keeps the film's view count off its public page and the profile cards, available_countries: where the film can be bought, rented and watched — null for everywhere or a list of ISO country codes; the film page stays visible everywhere and viewers outside the list see a 'Not available in your region' notice instead of the offers, and hide_trailer_outside_countries to withhold the trailer there too), how it is released (access: free = Free to watch, which needs no price; paid = Buy or rent) and its buy/rent prices in US cents (minimum $1.00), or the Earn settings (ads_enabled, ads_on_paid_plays, ad_formats, spotlighted — only where get_film shows earn). Nothing in these tools deletes a film, a season, an episode or a file: the user does that themselves in the film editor (the edit link). Offer what can be undone instead: unpublish it. Only the fields given are changed; the same validation as the film editor applies, and a published film whose publish checklist no longer passes returns to draft. The poster is not set here: start_film_file_upload opens a browser link for it (or it is added in the film editor). The main film is replaced with start_film_upload, never detached.

access.description: How the film is released: free (Free to watch) or paid (Buy or rent; needs at least one price to publish).

ad_formats.description: Earn: which ad formats may show on this film (banner = Text banner, overlay = Visual overlay, pause = Pause ad, end_screen = End-screen ad, pre_roll = Pre-roll video). null = the account's default formats (get_film earn.account_ad_formats), [] = none; pre_roll shows only if listed. The list is replaced as a whole.

ads_enabled.description: Earn: show ads on this film. Dismissible formats over the trailer and free full-film plays (never over previews); off by default.

ads_on_paid_plays.description: Earn: show the same ads to buyers and renters of a Buy-or-rent film or series. Off by default; does nothing while ads_enabled is off. Cannot be turned on for a free-to-watch feature, which has no buyers or renters.

age_rating.description: Age rating of the whole title (a series' rating covers every episode): all = All ages, 13 = 13+, 16 = 16+, 18 = 18+. An 18+ title asks viewers to confirm they're 18 or over before it plays. Sexual content or nudity makes a film 18+. Required to publish; once chosen it can be changed but not cleared.

allow_search_engines.description: "Allow search engines to discover this film" (on by default). Off keeps the page reachable by its link but hides it from search engines and the sitemap.

available_countries.description: "Where viewers can buy and watch": null = everywhere (the default); a list of ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 codes = only these countries, replaced as a whole. Viewers elsewhere still see the film page, but can't buy, rent or watch. The film page itself stays visible everywhere, so festivals, press and distributors can still find it. Availability is decided by the viewer's IP address, which a VPN can get around. Viewers whose country can't be determined count as outside the list. A series is limited once; its episodes follow.

awards.description: Wins, nominations and festival selections (festival, award, year, proof_url). A working public HTTPS proof_url is required for new or edited entries and becomes the award’s public link after approval; changing it requires a fresh review. Omit it only to preserve an unchanged existing entry; the list is replaced as a whole. Each entry is checked by the Vidreno team before it shows publicly: an unchanged entry keeps its verification, a new or edited one starts as pending.

buy_price.description: Buy price in US cents (minimum 100); null removes it. Only used when access is paid.

camera.description: Compatibility field: sets a single camera (the list becomes that one; null clears it). Prefer cameras; ignored when cameras is given.

camera_model.description: The camera models, typed as the filmmaker would ("ALEXA Mini LF, FX3"), shown on the film page under the camera makes; null clears it. Cleared when capture_formats is no-camera.

cameras.description: Every camera make it was shot on: red = RED, arri = ARRI, sony = Sony, canon = Canon, blackmagic = Blackmagic, panasonic = Panasonic, iphone = iPhone, other = Other; the list is replaced as a whole, [] clears it. At least one is required to publish unless capture_format is no-camera.

capture_format.description: Compatibility field: sets a single format (the list becomes that one; null clears it). Prefer capture_formats; ignored when capture_formats is given.

capture_formats.description: Everything it was shot on, e.g. digital and 16mm: no-camera = No camera used, digital = Digital, 16mm = 16mm film, 35mm = 35mm film, super8 = Super 8, other-film = Other film stock; the list is replaced as a whole, [] clears it. no-camera stands alone (it cannot be combined with other formats) and clears the cameras. At least one is required to publish.

cast.description: Cast line, comma separated; null clears it.

comments_enabled.description: Whether viewers can comment on the film page.

confirm_animation_review.description: When newly combining Animation and Made with AI, explain this notice and pass true only if the creator chooses to keep Animation: Animation is for work in which artists created the movement. If you choose both Animation and Made with AI, a member of our team will check the title. We may ask for a short example of your process. If AI generated all the moving shots, we’ll remove the Animation genre.

content_descriptors.description: Content descriptors shown on the film page: none = None of these apply, sexual-content = Sexual content, nudity = Nudity, violence = Violence, strong-language = Strong language, drug-use = Drug use, disturbing = Horror / disturbing scenes. The list is replaced as a whole; choose none explicitly when no warnings apply. An empty list clears the answer and must be completed before publishing. Sexual content or nudity makes a film 18+. (age_rating must be 18 — the call is refused otherwise).

country.description: Country of production as an ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code (GB, US, FR…); null clears it.

detach.description: Retired: nothing here removes a file. Any value is refused; a file is removed by the user in the film editor.

director.description: Director line shown on the film page (credits are managed separately); null clears it.

expected_updated_at.description: Last get_film updated_at; rejects concurrent Studio changes. Read before editing and supply this value.

extra_links.description: Extra links shown on the film page (label + URL, up to 20). Replaces the whole list; an empty list clears it.

url.description: http(s) link, up to 500 characters (the film editor's limit).

film_id.description: The film's public id (from list_films / get_film).

filming_locations.description: Where it was filmed, as free-text places ("Glasgow, Scotland"); up to 10, the list is replaced as a whole.

genres.description: Genres from the fixed list (action = Action, adventure = Adventure, animation = Animation, biography = Biography, comedy = Comedy, crime = Crime, documentary = Documentary, drama = Drama, experimental = Experimental, family = Family, fantasy = Fantasy, history = History, horror = Horror, music = Music, musical = Musical, mystery = Mystery, romance = Romance, sci-fi = Science fiction, sport = Sport, thriller = Thriller, war = War, western = Western); up to 4, the list is replaced as a whole. At least one is required to publish.

hide_trailer_outside_countries.description: "Also hide the trailer outside these countries" (off by default; only applies with available_countries). By default the trailer still plays everywhere, so the film can be previewed where it isn't for sale.

listed_in_marketplace.description: Show in Discover/marketplace; false makes it unlisted while its link remains usable.

mostly_ai_generated.description: AI disclosure: true when "AI generated most of this film’s visuals". Tick this when generative AI produced most of the images viewers see. AI assistance with writing, editing, or cleanup alone does not count. Viewers will see ‘Made with AI’ on the title page.

original_language.description: Compatibility field: recognised language names/codes only. Prefer set_film_languages for canonical selections.

password.description: The film's "Password" (4–100 characters); null removes it. Only people with the link and the password can open it. It stays off Discover, your storefront and search engines. Buyers, renters, the owner and the Vidreno team skip it; changing it locks out everyone who used the old one.

release_at.description: The title's release date (a film or a whole series): an ISO 8601 date-time with a time zone (e.g. 2026-12-27T18:00:00Z). With one still ahead, publishing puts the page up with the trailer, the description and the date: people can buy or rent it ahead (a pre-order) and nobody can watch until then; it opens by itself at that time. null = no date (out as soon as it is published); on a title published ahead of its date, null releases it now. A title that is already out, or that people have already bought, cannot be moved behind a date.

release_year.description: Release year (1880–2100, the film editor's own range); null clears it.

rent_price.description: Rental price in US cents (minimum 100); null removes it. Only used when access is paid.

rental_window_hours.description: How long a rental lasts, in hours.

short_description.description: A short introduction for the film page and Discover; null clears it.

show_view_count.description: "Show view and favourite counts publicly" (on by default). Shows the film's views and favourites on its page and on your profile. Off keeps both numbers to you in Studio.

spotlighted.description: Earn: offer this film to advertisers (Spotlight): lists its poster, title and genre where advertisers pick films to run on. Only matters while ads are on and the film is published.

student_film.description: Made as a student film: Made while studying, as coursework or a graduation film.

tech_specs.description: Free-text tech specs shown on the film page (lenses, aspect ratio, resolution, sound mix…), one per line if several; null clears it.
